noticia: Porzingis (undisclosed) returned Wednesday to the Warriors' practice facility, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
Team president Tim Connelly believes DiVincenzo (Achilles) will return at some point this season, Jack Borman of the Locked On Wolves Podcast reports.
Ingram had surgery on his foot/heel during the offseason, ESPN's Brian Windhorst reported Tuesday.
Collins (toe) is hopeful to play Wednesday against the Raptors, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
Kennard (knee) has been ruled out for the Suns' final game of the preseason Friday against Utah, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.
Jackson has been ruled out for Friday's exhibition against the Hornets due to an ankle injury, Chris Herrington of The Daily Memphian reports.
Aldama (knee) is doubtful for Wednesday's game against Houston, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
Miller's path to a larger role became more difficult with the Clippers' acquisition of Max Strus.
Ighodaro (hip) won't play in Friday's preseason game against Utah, Kellan Olson of ArizonaSports.com reports.
Monk (rest) is out for Tuesday's preseason game against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

Hukporti didn't return to Monday's preseason game against the Knicks due to an Achilles injury and will undergo an MRI on Tuesday, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports. He didn't score (0-1 FG, 0-1 3Pt) and recorded one assist in five minutes before exiting.
Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Ament (ankle) didn't play in Friday's 128-127 preseason win over the Pacers in overtime.
Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.
Veesaar recorded 20 points (7-12 FG, 4-6 3Pt, 1-2 FT), four rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block over 23 minutes during Monday's 102-90 Las Vegas Summer League win over the Celtics.
Biberovic (heel) is unlikely to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Rockets, per Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com.
Diop (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

titular: Shut down for rest of season
noticia: Niederhauser has been diagnosed with a Lisfranc injury in his right foot and will require surgery. He's been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work but is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

titular: To miss at least two weeks
noticia: Cardwell will miss at least two weeks with a left calf strain, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Sexton (lower leg) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

titular: To miss at least two weeks
noticia: The Grizzlies announced Friday that Stewart (ankle) will miss at least two weeks.
Howard (illness) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Hawks.
Carter (illness) agreed to a two-way deal with the Celtics on Saturday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Grant won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Hornets due to soreness, Chris Herrington of The Daily Memphian reports.
Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.
Strawther (knee) will undergo an MRI on Thursday morning, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
Hinson (hamstring) is listed as out for Friday's preseason game against Phoenix.
Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's preseason game against Miami.
Awaka (knee) is out for Friday's preseason finale versus Minnesota, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
